description: This file defines an interface 'ILogViewAdaptorHost' with generic types for log view and log entry, used by grains implementing log-view consistency in Orleans. It provides methods for updating views and handling state change notifications, and extends connection issue listener behavior.

classes.name: ILogViewAdaptorHost
classes.description: Interface for grains utilizing log-view consistency, providing methods to update the log view and notify about state changes, with support for handling connection issues.

methods.name: UpdateView
methods.description: Updates the log view with a new view and log entry, catching and logging exceptions internally.

methods.name: OnViewChanged
methods.description: Notifies the host about changes in tentative or confirmed state, with internal handling of exceptions.
